      ./about

      A place to slow down
      and taste something real.

      Coffee culture runs deep in everything we do. We carefully select each single-origin lot, brew it simply, and let the cup speak for itself. Yebou is Doha's space for discovery.

      "Every cup should feel right for you. If it doesn't — tell us. We'll make it right."
